visual_history.assessment:
- The legs are incorrectly oriented; they overlap in the center rather than forming two distinct parallel supports.
- Proportions are too spindly, making the table look fragile and visually thin in renders.
- The "inverted-U" structure is poorly defined because the top bar is completely hidden by the tabletop.
- Wood grain planks are barely visible due to lack of contrast/depth.

- The current legs are square posts; "sled-style" requires flat, ribbon-like rectangular profiles to be visually accurate.
- The "shelf structure" consists only of two thin bars; it needs a physical surface (a shelf) to properly represent a "structure".
- The wood-grain simulation (planks) is too subtle; increasing the number of planks and adjusting gaps will make the detail more apparent in renders.
